sources.note: Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. Its contact page gives the commercial office at San Martin 5035, Vicente López, the phone and the email.

notes: The address on the shop is the Vicente López commercial office; the productive unit is the farm the map registers at Concordia.
